newsitem.title: USA: Home sees $1 mln reduction to Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Home sees $1 mln reduction to Q4 earnings.

text.p: Home Bancorp said on Friday that, based on an estimated federal and state tax rate of 40 percent, it expects after-tax earnings in its fiscal fourth quarter to be reduced by about $1 million because of a one-time charge.

The company said new federal legislation passed on September 30 as part of the appropriations bill, calls for a special one-time assessment of 65.7 basis points on Savings Association Insurance Fund (SAIF)-insured deposits that were held at March 31, 1995.
The assessment will bring the SAIF's reserve ratios to a level comparable with the Bank Insurance Fund, at 1.25 percent of total insured deposits.

"The effective passage correlates with the last day of our fiscal year ended September 30 and will result in an estimated assessment pretax charge of $1,650,000 in the 1996 fiscal year fourth quarter," said chief executive foficer W. Paul Wolf.
